skills.description: This skill should be used when the user provides a journal article as EITHER a web page URL (网刊论文链接, e.g. 宇航学报 yhxb.org.cn) OR a source PDF (.pdf 原文), and wants a 公众号论文解读 HTML generated in the established 宇航学报 blue layout. For 研究论文 (research articles) an optional author-provided Word attachment supplies 前景与应用/团队介绍; for 综述文章 (review articles) NO Word is needed — all four sections are interpreted by AI directly from the source and must stay faithful to the original. It auto-detects URL vs PDF input, extracts text and original paper figures, handles formula/symbol typesetting for WeChat, and produces article_body.html (paste-ready) + article_preview.html. Trigger phrases include 论文链接生成公众号, 论文PDF生成公众号, 原文PDF解读, 综述生成公众号.
skills.description_zh: This skill should be used when the user provides a journal-article web page URL (网刊论文链接, e.g. 宇航学报 yhxb.org.cn) plus an author-provided Word attachment, and wants a 公众号论文解读 HTML generated in the established 宇航学报 blue layout. It fetches the page, extracts text and original paper figures from the URL, handles formula/symbol typesetting for WeChat, and produces article_body.html (paste-ready) + article_preview.html. Trigger phrases include 论文链接生成公众号, 网刊URL转推送, 论文解读HTML.
